description_expanded:
This beautiful new home South of 30A offer quick access to the beach down the Turtle Bale pedestrian path. Guests of the home will find a courtyard with covered seating, a built-in grill and a private pool. The first level of the home offers a spacious family room with ample seating, dining area and kitchen with a large center island. This level also offers the first bedroom with a king-sized bed. On the second level, guests will find the primary suite with king-sized bed, a third bedroom with a king-sized bed and a fourth bedroom with bunk beds (full-sized upper and lower). All bedrooms have private baths. The third level offers a spacious patio with an outdoor table and couch seating as well as a half-bath and slight views of the Gulf. Parking for this home is in two designated spaces in a parking court. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.

Alys Beach is expanding its development surrounding 16 Kings Castle Court. The photography above may not reflect the current views as impacted by construction. For a construction map, please click the link below.
